dialogue.t: Hey, we meet again. Hmm? You're with Paimon this time?
Huh? Paimon was here when we meditated here the last time...
Is that so? I don't remember.
No matter. It's all thanks to you that I found the location of the Looking Glass and the flowers that are about to bloom, and deepened my understanding of this place.
Hmm... Talking to Canotila is as confusing as ever.
Woof!
Hmm? But...
Woof, woof!
Okay, okay! I hear you.
(Hmm...? She's talking to the puppy? Could it be that Melusine can generally communicate with dogs?)
Well, I guess that's that. I'll see you next time. Hmph! Even if you said that, I'm still coming back to play with you.
Let's go, Mr.(Ms.) {NICKNAME}, Paimon!
Well. Here we are again...
What is it?
I feel really bad for saying this since everyone's so nice to me, all of you, but...
Don't you feel the real world is so frighteningly dull? Don't you think the world in the Book is far more beautiful?
Really? You think so too, huh?
I still feel the world in the Book of Revealing is much more appealing. There are dew-covered petals everywhere, and I've finally made friends with the puppy.
That puppy... Uh, Canotila, can you communicate with dogs?
Hm? Of course not. However, the puppy in the Book of Revealing is special. Or maybe, I'm special?
I've been meditating to travel to the world in the Book, and then one day, the puppy's usual barking turned into something I could understand.
As for what we talked about... He asked me to go and never come back.
But... I still want to see the sunflowers bloom...
I—Is that so... Take care, Canotila! We'll be going!
